text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! ♪ Oh, it's just so fun to race
with
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And! And! I think I've gotten stronger!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I can even keep up with everyone now!
Isn't that
amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I can even keep up with everyone now!
Isn't that
amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! I'm gonna get first place in
this next
race for sure! I can sense it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So I better hurry up and prep for
interviews! Hey,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's practice together! I'll take the role
of the
host!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You got nothing to worry about!
We'll
practice lots and lots!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Scary! Wh-why do you say that?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I've seen that on TV! You're like
those
coaches telling me to give it my
all! Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, roger that! I'll try even harder!
Giving it my
all is my specialty, after all!
